digest.component_or_area: CLI commands (edit, claim) and plan-review gate integration
propositions: edit --review must parse as a valueless flag without consuming the next token, then invoke rebar.llm.review_plan(ticket_id, sign=True) strictly after the EDIT event is committed and exit with disposition mapping (0 PASS / 1 BLOCK / 2 INDETERMINATE / 11 retryable) via _disposition_exit_code

claim --review must check gate applicability via _plan_review_gate_applies, call llm.claim_gate_check, and only invoke the claim core if review returns PASS; on BLOCK/INDETERMINATE/retryable it must exit with the disposition code and print the review summary without attempting the claim
claim --review must print a notice and proceed with the claim when the plan-review gate does not apply (disabled or exempt type), and must never propagate the flag through the parent-first cascade

Both --review flags must obtain _disposition_exit_code via lazy in-function import; the store lock must not be held while the review runs; and a raising review_plan must propagate through the standard CLI error handler

Help sources (edit.txt, claim.txt) must document non-atomicity and reference review-plan --status; docs/exit-codes.md must document the --review exit codes and state flagless contracts are unchanged; docs/cli-reference.md must be regenerated
